evidence_quotes.agenda: "Before I get all the details of your move, I just like to ask sir if you have any concern about the moving process or do you have any worries for this move?" — asked before logistics probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — "Not really" to the concern question; the follow-up about boxes-vs-furniture was a service-scope clarification, not concern-digging
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if you are really ready on the move day like our movers will just focus on loading everything into the truck, then that would really help you keep the time down" / "if the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used"

top_strength: Genuine, easy rapport (the broken-TV exchange landed as real conversation, not scripted small talk) and a well-personalized estimate anchor citing the third-floor walk, washer/dryer, and drive time.
coaching_note: Never asked for the booking at all — customer said he had one more call to make to shop around, and this was the exact moment to make an explicit close attempt (even just the ask) instead of letting the call end without one.
